MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Court Trial/Prov-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Joyce Long.
David Brillant, Esq. for Plaintiff: Gerda Kircher.
Plaintiff's witness: Bruce Sandifer and Karen Hartje-Fout, were sworn and direct examined.
No appearance by the Defendants: Richard Hill, defaulted, and Michelle Binder.
Exhibit 1 - Three-day notice-----------------------------------ID/EVID.
Exhibit 2 - Declaration of Bruce Sandifer----------------------ID/EVID.

Restitution and possession of the premises located at 1272 Market St., #309, San Francisco.
Back Rent and Damages of $2960.08
Costs $151.30
Rental Agreement declared forfeited.
Counsel stipulated for the return of the Exhibits in open court
